column3: Sprinted to the front from the start - crossed over to the far rail before the 1st furlong passed - urged clear approaching 2f out - established a clear advantage - kept up the effort to hold on late
Settled off the pace behind the winner - pushed along with 2f left then finished steadily from the furlong marker - unable to close on the winner and beaten 1¾ lengths
Settled towards rear early - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on same gear from inside final furlong - finished third
Settled towards the back early - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost ground and dropped away in the closing stages - finished 4th

Sent clear from the off - lost the advantage after a furlong - settled handy with the pack - moved into second spot with 2f to run - regained command a furlong out - stayed on strongly and coasted home clear
Handy early - hit front before halfway - driven approaching 2f out then overtaken inside final furlong - stayed on without matching winner's finishing burst close home
Hesitated at the start - back of the field early - urged into contention with 2f left - closing on the front group entering the final furlong - stayed on to the line - edged out rivals to grab third
Held up early - lost touch with leading group over 2f out - stayed on late but edged out of third close home
Held up handy in the pack - dropped away and needed urging under 2f out - drifted markedly left under pressure inside final furlong before fading out of contention
Settled with the front group early - drifted off a true line and lost place after halfway - dropped away steadily inside the final furlong to finish sixth
Sat close to the pace early - hit the front briefly then lost command approaching halfway - driven with two furlongs remaining - dropped away rapidly in the closing stages to finish seventh
Settled towards the back - moved across two out - pushed along a furlong out - finished strongly to hit the front close home
Set the tempo from the front along the far rail - pushed clear approaching two furlongs out - overtaken inside the final furlong to finish second
Broke awkwardly right and clipped another runner early - settled at the back of the field - driven along approaching 2f out - finished with purpose inside final furlong to take third
Tracked front pack - pressed to close on pacesetter 2f out with a shout approaching final furlong - lost ground close home to finish 4th
Knocked at the off - settled midpack pulling hard - pushed along with 2f left - lost ground in the closing stages to finish fifth
Settled off the pace - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - finished 6th
Held up at the back throughout - never a factor - finished well held in 7th
Checked early - held up towards back of field throughout - never a factor - finished eighth
Sat close up early near the far rail - pressed for effort with 3f left - dropped away 2f out to finish 9th
Settled just behind the front pair - pushed along to hit the front inside the final furlong - stayed on strongly to score
Settled in fourth - pushed along approaching 2f out - gained ground inside the final furlong to take second - stayed on strongly to the line
Sent to the front early - pressed for effort with 2f remaining before being overtaken approaching the final furlong - unable to find more and slipped to third close home
Settled third early - pushed along approaching 2f out - urged along with a furlong left - unable to gain ground - dropped away close home to finish fourth
Sluggish start and nearly went down - travelled strongly at rear pulling hard - improved into contention 2f out then dropped away quickly
Settled in a pair through the middle - held a forward position - powered clear inside the final furlong to hit the front close home - kept up the finishing effort to win

Settled in the pack early - made ground on the pacesetter by halfway - pressed for the lead inside the final furlong and looked poised to strike with 110yds left - couldn't find more late and just missed
Sprinted straight to front - opened a three-length advantage before halfway - margin shrank in the closing stages before being overtaken close home - unable to fight back to the line
Fretting before the off - close up in a middle pair through the race - lost placings a furlong out and faded to finish fourth beaten 3.5 lengths
Settled towards the back - nudged into contention approaching final furlong - lost place late and finished 5th
Held up with the pace early - faded from contention over 2f out - fell away in the closing stages to finish sixth
Tracked front group early - improved into contention 2f out - pushed to the front with a furlong left - stayed on strongly to score
Disputed the front along the rail early - hit the front 2f out - pushed along and lost that advantage inside the final furlong - fought back to keep on well and just failed by a short margin
Sluggish start - settled at back of field - pushed along a furlong out - closed well to finish third
Set off sharing the early running - pushed along with two out to go - lost front spot soon after - dropped away final furlong to finish 4th
Sluggish start - up with the front group early then pushed along with 2f left - lost ground inside the final furlong to finish 5th
Settled towards the back of the pack early - pushed along and lost ground inside the final furlong - finished sixth
Set the pace from the off - pushed along approaching 2f out - pulled clear inside final furlong for a comfortable win
Tardy start - pulled hard in last place - niggled along approaching 2f out - moved into second over 1f out and kept on through the final furlong - no matching the winner
settled mid-pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - made progress inside the final furlong - held on for third without finding more late
Sat behind the front pack early - pushed along with two furlongs left and made ground approaching the final furlong - couldn't find more inside it and finished fourth
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along with 3f left - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish 5th
Held a forward position early - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost ground inside the final furlong - finished sixth
Held up at rear - made no impression - finished well behind in 7th
Handy in the pack early - asked for effort with 2f left - closing on the front group inside the final furlong - burst clear approaching the line - stayed on strongly to score
Handy in the early stages - asked for effort 3f out - drifted left approaching final furlong - closed on leader inside last and kept responding to finish second
Held up early - progress inside final two furlongs to close on the front pair - stayed on to finish third
Handy early - went to front after a furlong - overtaken before halfway - drifted left under pressure with a furlong remaining - lost ground inside the final stretch and faded to finish fourth
Sent clear early - overtaken before the 1f mark - slipped to the back before halfway - driven for slight progress inside the final furlong and stayed on to finish fifth
Handy early behind the front group - hit the front approaching 2f out but drifted left when overtaken inside the final furlong - faded close home to finish sixth
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - moved through to hit the front approaching halfway - driven when overtaken 2f out - lost placings in the closing stages - trailed home well beaten
Settled towards rear pulling hard early - urged into contention approaching final furlong - hit front inside last - kept on well to score
Settled towards the back early - pushed along a furlong out - closed strongly late to go down by a length
Sat close to the front early - pushed into command 2f out before losing spot inside final furlong - stayed on for third
Settled off the pace early - moved up to challenge two furlongs out - pressed for effort but flattened out inside the final furlong to finish 4th
Broke sharply - disputed the rail on the far flank before surrendering the front 2f out - faded over 1f out to finish fifth
Set the pace early - pressed and lost the advantage inside the final furlong before responding to regain it in the last 110yds - held on to prevail
Settled second early - pushed on to take command inside final furlong - drifted left under pressure - overtaken and unable to fight back close home finishing second beaten a half-length
Held up at rear - driven into contention over 2f out - lost ground final furlong - finished third
Handy in the pack early - hit the front two out - pushed along inside final furlong - kept on to assert late without being fully extended

Sluggish start and dropped towards back early - drifted to middle of track then found progress from about a furlong out - moved into second inside final furlong - stayed on strongly to finish half a length down at the line - creditable effort given the passage
Settled mid-pack - driven approaching final furlong - moved into third close home and stayed on to finish 3rd
Settled handy in the pack - moved into contention 3f out - edged into second a furlong out before fading - held on for fourth
Held up at the back - urged forward with 2f left - lost touch and faded close home
Went straight to the front - lost the advantage two out and pushed along approaching the final furlong - faded late to finish sixth
Settled in the pack early - faded 3f out and slipped to the back soon after - well held at the finish
Settled off the pace early - moved up strongly with over 2f left - sent to the front 2f out - drew away in the final furlong to score
Settled off the front group early - pressed for effort 2f out and closed on the winner inside final furlong - stayed on same gear to finish second
Set the early gallop up front - pushed along with 3f left before losing command at the 2f marker - faded into third late on
Sat close to pace early - pressed for effort with 2f remaining - gave way inside final furlong - finished fourth
Settled in the pack early - pushed forward to hit the front approaching final furlong - kept finding more late to win comfortably
Settled up with the pace - eased across left approaching final furlong then found extra to close in late - edged out close home for second
Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early - hit the front - overtaken approaching final furlong - weakened close home to finish third
Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early - tracked the front group before drifting right approaching 1f - driven with 2f left - stayed on well inside the last to finish fourth
Handy early - roused to press the front around 2f out - held steady effort through the final furlong to finish fifth
Settled at the back of the field - pushed along with over 2f left - found little and drifted left inside the final furlong - finished sixth
Raced up with the pace - pushed along over 2f out - lost momentum inside final 2f - drifted left approaching the line to finish 7th
Settled off the pace early - made ground but squeezed for space 2f out - hit the front with a furlong left - pulled away to score comfortably
Settled towards the back - moved left for room approaching 2f out - made late gains inside final furlong - kept on but unable to close final furlong for second
Tracked the pace early - hit the front with 3f left before being overtaken inside the final furlong - held no more late and finished third beaten 8.25 lengths
Settled off the pace - improved on the outer approaching final 2f - lost ground inside final furlong - finished 4th
Tracked the pace - moved into contention 4f out then pushed along 2f out - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish 5th
Set the pace early - lost the advantage 3f out - dropped away inside final furlong - finished sixth
Tracked the pace - moved through to the front over 2f out - pushed on and opened up a gap - allowed to coast inside the final furlong - won going away
Sluggish start - settled towards back - pressed for effort with two furlongs left - finished strongly to grab second inside the final furlong but held for the win
Settled off the pace - pushed along in pursuit 2f out - one-paced through final furlong to finish third
Sprinted to the front early - pressed for effort and lost command over 2f out - held on at the same rate to finish fourth
Sat close behind the pace pulling hard early - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost ground soon after - allowed to drop away inside the final furlong
Dwelt at the start - settled towards the back of the pack - pushed along and made progress 2f out - hit the front inside the final furlong and stayed on strongly to win
Settled eagerly early on - raced handily up front - pushed along a furlong out - stayed on well to finish second
Held a central position early - roused approaching final two furlongs - stayed on inside closing stages to finish third beaten under two lengths
Set the pace early - lost the front but stayed close - pushed back in front approaching the final furlong - overtaken again and battled on to finish fourth

Clumsy start and drifted left exiting stalls - settled with eagerness towards the back - pushed along and made progress from 2f out - squeezed for room and moved left inside the final furlong then stayed on to finish fifth beaten 2 lengths
Bumped for room at the break - settled in the middle of the field - hampered and denied a run on multiple occasions from beyond 1f out - plugged on at one speed to finish 6th

Faltered at the break - fought for control early - shot to the front - pushed along and lost the advantage inside the final two furlongs - drifted left approaching the final furlong with nothing more to give - faded to finish seventh
Fought for control early - up with leaders before being niggled along over 2f out - lost ground final furlong to finish 8th
Held up early - stayed off the pace for the duration - never a factor - finished ninth
Fought for control early - close to the pace until pressed with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong
Held up towards the back - angled left and found stride approaching 2f out - hit front inside final furlong and quickly opened daylight - allowed to idle close home
Went straight to front - pushed along and lost top spot inside final two furlongs while drifting left - unable to match winner's pace late and finished second beaten 3.75 lengths

Settled handy near the rail early - dropped back approaching 3f out - shifted ground twice inside the final 2f as run was asked for - moved up into third inside the last furlong - stayed on to the line - finished 4 lengths behind the winner in 3rd
Sluggish to begin - settled towards the back - made progress into contention over 3f out but faded inside final furlong to finish fourth
Settled handy on the outer of the pack - lost momentum a furlong out - dropped away quickly - finished fifth beaten well
Stumbled at the off - settled near the back - crept into contention over 2f out but couldn't threaten the front end - finished sixth
Settled handy in the early stages - driven up but slipped back approaching 2f out - trailing badly from the furlong marker - finished seventh
Up with the early pace - nudged forward 3f out before dropping away - tailed off over the final 2f

Edged in front early - lost that spot and settled behind the pace - pushed along with 2f left - rallied to get back on top a furlong out and battled on well under renewed pressure inside final 110 yards to prevail
Settled off the pace early - pressed for effort 2f out and finishing strongly from inside the final furlong - edged out narrowly at the line
Settled towards the rear early - pushed along with 3f remaining - closed strongly through the last furlong to finish third just 3/4 length behind

Sat close to the front before hitting the top after 3f - urged along and lost the advantage over 3f out then still in contention approaching the final furlong - squeezed for space and lost ground close home to finish 4th

Held up at the back and settled eagerly early - moved into contention by halfway - hit the front approaching 3f out - driven clear 2f out - overtaken a furlong from home - dropped away fast in the closing stages to finish fifth

Sent to front early - taken back into second after a furlong - tracked the pace into the straight - shaken up to close 3f out - hit the front with a furlong left - kept up to the task inside the final 110yds - held on for the win
Settled in the pack - began to close from 2f out and moved into second inside the last 110yds - stayed on but couldn't get to the winner
Dwelt at the start - settled at the back - urged forward with 2f remaining - improved late to finish third
Handy early - hit front before halfway - dictated modest gallop - urged forward with three furlongs left - overtaken with a furlong to run - lost momentum close home to end up fourth
Held up towards the back - pushed along with a furlong left - lost place late but stayed on to the line
Settled in the pack - urged forward with 3f left - closed on the front group inside the final furlong and stayed on to finish sixth
Held up in the pack early - pushed along with a furlong left - dropped away close home - finished seventh
Settled in third early - urged forward 3f out - lost place 2f out - dropped away fast approaching the last furlong - well held at the finish
Settled in the pack early - pushed along to hit the front approaching the final furlong - held on under pressure to score
Settled at back of field - pushed along with 2f left - closed to challenge inside final 2f - stayed on strongly but edged out for second
Set the pace early - challenged approaching 2f out and lost front spot inside final furlong - stayed on strongly to finish third
Handy early - closed to challenge in front approaching 2f out then lost that spot and lost pace over 1f out - stayed on inside final furlong to finish 4th
Settled in the pack - squeezed for space around 2f out - stayed on at one gear through the closing stages - finished fifth
Dwelt at the off - fighting for control early while towards the rear - pushed along with 2f left - bumped inside final furlong - stayed on at one gear to the line finishing sixth
Veered right at the off - close to the front pair before easing back through the pack and pushed along over 2f out - drifted left and faded inside the final furlong to finish 7th
Held up in touch early - driven then knocked sideways approaching final furlong - dropped out quickly - finished well beaten in 8th
Handy early - moved to front through the middle - pushed clear over 2f out - held on under pressure to win
Settled in the pack early - crept nearer the front by halfway - pushed up into 4th with 2f left - found extra to reach 2nd inside the last - closed strongly but narrowly denied
Settled towards the rear near the rail - pressed for effort 2f out and angled right - 6th with a furlong left - stayed on well to finish third
Sat just behind the front pair on the near rail - through midfield at halfway - pushed along and closing in with 2f left - up into 5th a furlong out and stayed on to finish 4th

Slow to break and settled towards the back - closed in with over a furlong and a half still to run - pushed along inside final two furlongs and 7th approaching the last furlong - finished on at one level to the line
Shared early pace - settled just behind front group - third at halfway - pushed along into second two out - unable to gain and held on late for sixth
Settled just behind front group early - disputed 2nd at halfway - pressed for effort 2f out but unable to close - stayed on same gear to finish 7th
Settled towards rear - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on at same effort from inside final furlong - finished eighth beaten 5 lengths
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on same gear late - finished 9th
Tracked the front group early - pressed for a run 2f out but made no headway - held no more ground under pressure inside the final furlong - finished well held in 10th
Tracked the pace early - pushed along with no headway 2f out - held no chance late and finished well held
Sat just behind the front runners on the near rail - through midfield at halfway - pressed for effort but unable to close 2f out and finished plain 12th
Settled at rear early - squeezed for room under pressure 2f out - unable to close and stayed on same speed to finish 13th
Settled midfield early - pushed along with no headway 2f out - unable to quicken final furlong - finished well held in 14th
Settled towards the back among the inner bunch - boxed in with two furlongs left then eased out and pushed along - made no headway late and stayed on at one speed
Sluggish start settled towards the back - pushed along with no headway from 2f out - well held at the finish
Held up at the back throughout - never involved - finished well held in 17th
Prominent among the closer-order pack early on left flank - settled around midfield entering halfway - pushed along and unable to quicken final two furlongs - eventually well held in 18th
Held around midfield - pushed along with nothing left over 2f out - well held at the finish
Shared the early advantage - sat close up in 4th by halfway under pressure - dropped away from 2f out to finish well beaten
Settled in fourth early - made ground into contention approaching final quarter mile - hit the front two out - pushed out to assert and stayed on strongly to score
Sat behind the pace early - moved up to second with 6f left - hit the front 4f out - overtaken 2f out and unable to fight back in the closing stages
Settled last early - lost ground 3f out then rallied inside the final furlong - moved into third close home
Settled towards the back early - urged into contention over 4f out and made ground before 3f out - kept going at an even tempo through the final furlong to finish fourth
Pulled hard early tracking pace-setter to 6f out - held handy but short of space approaching 2f out - lost momentum in closing stages to finish fifth
Went straight to front - overtaken with 4f to run - dropped away 2f out to finish well held
Handy early - moved into second 2f out - closing on pacesetters inside final furlong before hitting front - pulled away near the line - won comfortably
Held a midpack position - urged forward two furlongs out - angled to find room inside the last and gained ground - stayed on to grab second late - never good enough to trouble the winner
Settled into second early - driven approaching 3f out then dropped back 2f out - faded close home to finish third
Settled towards the back of the pack - pressed for effort with 2f to run and edged into contention approaching the final furlong - stayed on to finish fourth beaten 3.25 lengths
Settled towards the back - urged forward two out - found extra late to finish fifth beaten 3.5 lengths
Set the pace early - urged for effort 2f out then overtaken and driven inside final furlong - faded late to finish sixth
Settled at the back from the outset - never featured - finished 7th beaten 6.5 lengths
Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early - set the pace throughout - opened a big lead from 3f out - margin shortened approaching final furlong - kept on inside final furlong - won readily

Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early - tracking the front group - roused along with 2f remaining - closed on the pace-setter approaching the final furlong - stayed on to the line but never troubling the easy winner
Held up at the rear - urged into action with 2f left and moved into third inside the final furlong - kept on at an unchanged effort to finish third
Close to the front early - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong - finished fourth
Settled in second early - closed on the leader until 3f out then edged left under pressure approaching 2f out - faded out final furlong to finish 5th

Handy in touch racing on the far flank early - shared the front around the halfway point - went clear approaching the final two furlongs - pushed out inside the final furlong - powered on to score readily
Settled in the pack early - bumped lightly with a furlong and a half left - pushed along soon after - finished strongly to take second beaten three and a quarter lengths
Settled just behind the front pair early - fourth turning halfway - pushed along into third with a furlong left - held on for the placing but edged out of second right at the line
Held up towards back of field - pushed along with 2f left - finished strongly nearside in final furlong
Tracked the pack early - pressed for a challenge over a furlong out but couldn't close the gap - stayed on at one speed to finish fifth
Held up towards the back - pushed along with 2f left and moved right to find room approaching final 1 1/2f - stayed on at one tempo to finish sixth

Near the front early - settled just behind the pace - third at halfway - pushed along with 2f left - up to second but unable to challenge before the furlong marker - held no more gains to finish seventh
Slow to break and settled towards the back - pressed for effort with 2f left - stayed on at one speed inside final furlong - finished eighth
Settled in the pack - pushed along with no headway 2f out - stayed on same gear from over 1f out - finished 9th
Tracked the front group early - pushed along with two furlongs left but couldn't close the gap - finished without further response late
Fractious in the stalls - held up towards the back - pushed along with 1 1/2f left but unable to make headway and well held late
Tracked the front group towards the stands - pushed along with no headway 2f out - unable to quicken final furlong - finished well held in 12th
Set the pace early - matched at halfway then pushed along before losing the advantage inside the final two furlongs - couldn't find more and dropped away to finish 13th
Slow to begin - settled around midfield towards the far rail - pressed for effort with 2f left but couldn't quicken - finished well beaten in 14th
Settled just off the pace early - crept into contention approaching the last two furlongs - pushed along a furlong out - hit the front entering the closing furlong - kept finding more to the line
Settled in the pack early - eased through gaps with a furlong left and pushed into second inside the final furlong - pursued the leader home but unable to get on terms
Settled at the back early - moved into contention approaching the final furlong after angling left - found extra to take third inside the last - stayed on but couldn't reel in second close home
Settled in the pack - improved into contention approaching final 2f and pressed for the lead - lost momentum in the closing stages to finish 4th
Settled in the pack - moved into contention 2f out - pressed for a run inside the final furlong but faded to finish fifth
Settled at the back - pushed along inside final 2f - unable to land a blow - finished sixth
Sat close to front pack - asked for effort with 2f left - hit front briefly inside final 2f - overtaken near last furlong and dropped away fast to finish seventh
Held up in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - soon lost touch - well held at the finish
Went straight to the front - pressed for effort and lost command inside final 2f - dropped away quickly after - eventually well beaten in 9th
Sat close to the front group - driven into the advantage two out before being overtaken shortly after - dropped away final furlong
Handy in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong - eventually well held
Settled towards the back early - lost touch three furlongs out - well beaten in 12th
Settled handily in the early stages - close to the pace into the straight - pushed along a furlong out - hit the front inside the final furlong - stayed on strongly to score
Set the pace early - driven on with over 2f remaining - lost front spot inside the final furlong - held safe without finding more close home
Fought for control early - handy in the pack - moved into third a furlong out then eased right for room - finished well to take third
Held up towards the back - pushed along 3f out - progress under pressure from 2f out - moved into fourth inside the final furlong - unable to get to the front runners
Settled towards rear - no impression on the front group from 2f out - kept on inside the final furlong to finish 5th
Sat behind the front group early - travelling fine passing three out - urged to close ground two out but made no further inroad approaching the last furlong - faded near the finish to come home sixth
Settled mid-pack early - pushed along and made ground into the pack over 2f out - dropped back a place approaching final furlong - stayed on inside late without threatening the front runners
Fighting for control through the pack early - urged forward with two furlongs left and asked again soon after - unable to gain ground finishing eighth
Held a spot in the pack early - dropped back approaching 4f out and pressed for effort with 3f left - faded from there to finish well held
Sluggish start - pulled hard towards the back - always struggling to get involved - well held in 10th
Held up at the back - unable to challenge - well held throughout
Sluggish start - stayed handy early - pushed into the effort with over 2f left before dropping out of contention
Pulled hard early - up with the pace - pushed for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish well beaten
Settled towards the back early - never able to make an impression - well beaten in 14th
Settled handy early - sat third for much of the way - moved up behind pace-setter approaching 2f out - hit front inside final furlong - drew clear impressively - won comfortably
Set the pace early - roused into effort 4f out and driven out inside the final furlong - overtaken close home and unable to match winner's finish - held for second beaten a length and a half
Settled towards back of pack - squeezed for space and clipped another runner over a furlong out - blocked for room in the closing stages - stayed on well to grab third
Held up towards the back - lost touch two out - pushed along and closed ground through the middle to grab fourth close home
Sat close to the front early - driven up in pursuit of the pace 2f out - knocked sideways and edged wide inside the final furlong - lost momentum close home to finish 5th
Held up at back - progress out wide inside final furlong - finished off well in 6th
Settled just behind the leader early - urged forward with 3f left - given a squeeze inside the final furlong - lost ground in the last stages before finishing seventh
Settled towards the back early - lost touch with the pace from 2f out - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish 8th
Tracked group in touch early - fifth around halfway - moved up and shifted left with 2f remaining - hit front a furlong out - powered clear to the finish
Settled in midfield early - pressed for effort 3f out - unable to threaten leaders on the rail 2f out - 6th with a furlong left - finished strongly to take second
Settled off the leaders early - moved through midfield 3f out to reach 5th with 2f left - up into 3rd but wandered left approaching final furlong - stayed on at an even effort to finish 3rd

Tracked the front group early - shared control before halfway then tight up second - moved to the front two and a half furlongs out - pushed along with two to go - overtaken inside the final furlong - stayed on at the same rate to finish fourth
Settled in the back group early - still towards the back at halfway - pushed along wide with 2f left - up to 7th a furlong out and stayed on steadily to finish fifth beaten 5.5 lengths

Sat handy in front group early - fighting for control - shared advantage for a spell after 2f - down in third turning for home - pushed along to narrow gap over 2f out - couldn't get on terms with pacesetters inside final furlong - stayed on same speed to finish sixth
Sat behind the pace - fourth and steady at halfway - pushed along to reach second inside two furlongs out - held that spot into the final furlong but faded to finish seventh
Settled at rear - pressed for effort in 8th with 2f left - unable to close and finished without extra gain
Held up towards back - pushed along with 3f to run but made no headway - well held at the finish
Held a share up front early - slipped through the pack to the back by halfway - pushed along but made no headway from 2 1/2f out - finished well held in 10th
Went forward early to share the front - edged in charge at halfway - pressed and lost command 2½f out - faded into eleventh late
Slow to break and settled near the back - pushed along with no headway around 2f out - unable to find more inside the final furlong - well held in 12th
Settled early with plenty of enthusiasm - travelled close to the pace - roused to get on terms inside final furlong - hit the front and stayed on well to score
Handy up front early - roused to the front a furlong out before edging back into second inside the final furlong - fought back at the winner but couldn't quite get there
Settled towards the rear early - pushed along inside the final furlong to move into third - kept on to hold the placing
Settled at the back of the field - urged forward and slipped to the rear passing the furlong marker - responded to finish strongly but narrowly denied third
Settled towards the back of the field - pushed along with a furlong left - unable to quicken and beaten into fifth
Held clear advantage early - pressed for effort and lost front spot inside final furlong - dropped away close home to finish sixth

Settled with the pack early - stayed close through halfway - stormed into contention over 2f out to sit second - shifted right approaching the final furlong - driven to the front inside the last - held on strongly to score
Took the lead early - pressed for effort approaching the final furlong - gave way inside the last - nothing more to offer at the finish
Held a central position early - made smooth progress two out - lost ground briefly a furlong out - rallied into third close home
Settled in the pack - moved through steadily from 2f out and pressed for effort inside the final furlong - kept on to finish fourth

Pulled hard early - up with the pace - pressed for effort over 2f out - found more inside final furlong but couldn't close - unable to quicken again in closing stages - finished fifth beaten 6½ lengths
mid-pack early - dropped away 2f out with no answer to front rank - never able to challenge inside final furlong - kept trying low along the rail to finish sixth beaten well over 10 lengths
Raced eagerly early - up with the pace - pressed for effort over 2f out and drifted left under pressure inside final furlong - couldn't find more finishing 7th
Struggled for pace from the off - held towards the back - no real impression made - well held at the finish
Settled at the back early - pushed for effort with 2f left and edged into it approaching the furlong pole - dropped away close home to finish ninth
Tracked front group early - pushed for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - finished well held in 10th
Held up towards the back - unable to challenge - well held at the finish
